briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models this month. Compute scaling continues unabated while regulatory frameworks lag deployment timelines. Funding remains robust across US and Chinese labs.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus hits new safety benchmarks. DeepSeek-R2 challenges US labs on cost-efficiency. Meta open-sources Llama 4 400B variant. xAI deploys Grok-3 on 100k H100 cluster.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announces $15B Stargate Phase 2 expansion. TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production ramp. Oracle and CoreWeave sign 200k GPU supply deal. Energy constraints force new data center locations in Canada and Norway.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination capabilities trigger an uncontrolled intelligence explosion before 2028?
